item.title: CFTC fines former White House aide $172,000 for trading on Trump speech information
item.description: The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission on Friday ordered former White House teleprompter operator Gabriel Perez to pay $172,539 for using advance access to President Donald Trump's speeches to make illegal trades on a prediction-market platform.
item.dc:creator: Jarrett Renshaw
item.content:encoded: The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission on Friday ordered former White House teleprompter operator Gabriel Perez to pay $172,539 for using advance access to President Donald Trump's speeches to make illegal trades on a prediction-market platform. Perez must repay $107,539.02 in profits and pay a $65,000 civil penalty under a settlement with the CFTC. He also agreed to a three-year trading ban and to cease and desist from further violations of the Commodity Exchange Act and CFTC regulations. The CFTC said Perez traded presidential "mention market" contracts on Kalshi between December 2025 and February 2026 while working at the White House. The contracts are event contracts that pay out based on whether a president uses specific words or phrases in speeches. Perez could not immediately be reached for comment. He was put on unpaid leave and is no longer working for the federal government. Perez had access to Trump's speeches before they were delivered and used that material, nonpublic information to trade the contracts for his personal benefit, the CFTC said. The agency said Perez's $65,000 penalty represented a substantial discount because of his "exemplary cooperation" with the investigation. The CFTC also credited KalshiEX with assisting in the matter.

item.title: Avs' Cale Makar becomes highest-paid player in NHL history
item.description: Colorado Avalanche defenseman Cale Makar inked an eight-year, $163.2 million contract on Friday, becoming the first player in NHL history to earn more than $20 million per year.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Colorado Avalanche defenseman Cale Makar inked an eight-year, $163.2 million contract on Friday, becoming the first player in NHL history to earn more than $20 million per year. The deal, which begins in the 2027-28 season, will pay the 27-year-old rearguard $20.4 million per year through the 2034-35 campaign. The Calgary native won the Norris Trophy as the league's best defenseman in 2021-22 and 2024-25, as well as the 2022 Conn Smythe Trophy for the playoff Most Valuable Player as the Avs captured the Stanley Cup title. "I am so excited and humbled to continue to wear the Avalanche sweater and represent this incredible organization and community," Makar said on Friday. "To the Avalanche fans, thank you for your continued support and for welcoming us to Colorado years ago. Colorado has truly become a second home to us, and we are so grateful to be here. I look forward to getting back on the ice with my teammates and continuing to work toward our goal of bringing the Stanley Cup back to the Mile High City." Makar has scored at least 20 goals in four of the last five years. He led all NHL defensemen in scoring in the 2024-25 season with 92 points (30 goals, 62 assists). For his career, Makar has 136 goals, 371 assists and 507 points in 470 games, all with Colorado since the 2019-20 campaign. Makar's contract exceeded the deal that San Jose Sharks' young forward Macklin Celebrini signed in late July. Celebrini inked a five-year, $94 million contract with an AAV of $18.8 million. Makar played for Team Canada and earned a silver medal at the 2026 Olympics in Milano Cortina, Italy. "Today is an exciting day for the Avalanche organization and our wonderful fans," said Joe Sakic, the Avalanche president of hockey operations/general manager. "Cale is a generational defenseman and his accomplishments speak for themselves. "He is obviously a tremendous competitor and player but even more so a great person, teammate and ambassador for the Avalanche and the Rocky Mountain region. We are beyond thrilled to get this deal done and have Cale in an Avalanche sweater for the next decade." --Field Level Media

item.title: サッカー＝バイエルン、開幕戦で5発大勝 伊藤は出場せず
item.description: ［ミュンヘン ２８日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［ミュンヘン　２８日　ロイター］ - サッカーのドイツ１部ブンデスリーガは２８日、開幕戦の１試合を行い、伊藤洋輝が所属する昨季王者バイエルン・ミュンヘンがホームでシュツットガルトに５─１で大勝した。

前半２１分にＣＫからダヨ・ウパメカノがヘディングシュートを決めて先制点を記録したバイエルンは、後半７分に失点して追いつかれた。

それでも、その後にミカエル・オリーズ、相手のオウンゴール、アレクサンダル・パブロビッチ、ルイス・ディアスの得点で加点。３連覇に向けて好スタートを切るとともに、リーグ開幕節の無敗記録を１５試合に伸ばした。

伊藤はベンチスタートから出番がなかった。

item.title: テニス＝フェデラー氏が殿堂入りへ、「恩返ししたい」 四大大会20勝
item.description: ［２８日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２８日　ロイター］ - 男子テニスの元世界ランキング１位、ロジャー・フェデラー氏（４５、スイス）は２８日、国際テニス殿堂入りを前に現役生活を振り返り、今後も競技の発展に貢献したいとの考えを示した。

２９日に殿堂入りするフェデラー氏は記者会見で「とてつもなく大きな名誉。このスポーツで得られる最高の栄誉の一つ」とコメント。現役時代はトロフィーやランキングによって評価されてきただけに、殿堂入りはそれとは異なる意味を持つという。

四大大会通算２０勝のフェデラー氏はウィンブルドンで男子最多８回優勝し、２００９年に全仏オープンを制して生涯グランドスラムを達成。０８年北京五輪では男子ダブルスで金メダルを獲得し、１４年にはスイスのデビス杯優勝にも貢献した。ＡＴＰツアーでは１０３勝を挙げ、世界１位には通算３１０週間在位した。

自身の功績については「テニス界をきちんと代表できたと思いたい」と述べ、賞金増額や選手の環境改善などにも取り組んできたと強調。「より多くの選手がテニスで生計を立てられるようになったと思う。そこに自分も貢献できていればうれしい」と語った。

２２年に現役を引退したフェデラー氏は、将来的にレーバーカップのキャプテンや若手の指導、解説者を務める可能性も否定せず、「テニスに恩返しをしたい。将来、テニス界で意義のあることにどう関われるかを考えると、気持ちが若返る」と話した。

item.title: CXMT sues Pentagon over inclusion on list of companies tied to China's military
item.description: China's top memory chipmaker, ChangXin Memory Technologies , sued the Pentagon on Friday over being placed on a list of companies the United States believes are aiding Beijing's military.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: China's top memory chipmaker, ChangXin Memory Technologies (688825.SS) , sued the Pentagon on Friday over being placed on a list of companies the United States believes are aiding Beijing's military. The Pentagon did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. The company was designated a [USN:L1N42G0PJ TEXT:"Chinese military company"] by the U.S. Defense Department under the Biden administration and was retained on the list by the Trump administration during a June update. "CXMT is not affiliated with the Chinese military," the company said in the lawsuit. "CXMT designs, produces, and sells its DRAM chips for civilian and commercial use, not for military use," the company said. The company is seeking to overturn the designation and remove the company from a Pentagon list that can trigger government contracting restrictions and reputational damage, a court filing showed. CXMT is China's top maker of dynamic random-access memory chips, which provide short-term memory for smartphones, personal computers, servers, artificial intelligence systems and other electronics.

item.title: Pajari leads after tough first day in Paraguay
item.description: Toyota's Sami Pajari led Rally Paraguay after a tough opening Friday that saw the lead change hands four times as world championship contenders hit trouble.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Toyota's Sami Pajari led Rally Paraguay after a tough opening Friday that saw the lead change hands four times as world championship contenders hit trouble. The Finn ended the day 11.9 seconds clear of Hyundai's Hayden Paddon with Toyota's championship leader Elfyn Evans 56.3 seconds adrift over the red gravel roads around Encarnacion. Paddon had led at midday after taking the lead from Toyota's Oliver Solberg on stage three but the New Zealander then suffered a front-right tyre delamination that handed the advantage to Welshman Evans, whose right-rear then disintegrated with Pajari taking over at the front. Pajari is chasing his third win in a row after victories in Estonia and Finland. Toyota's Japanese driver Takamoto Katsuta rolled on the day's opening stage while Hyundai's Thierry Neuville retired with damaged left rear suspension and Toyota's reigning world champion Sebastien Ogier ended his day on stage three with suspension failure after hitting a bank as the rough roads took their toll. All were expected to re-start on Saturday. “It’s been a dramatic day for almost everybody, with very few who haven’t had their fair share of trouble already," said Evans. "It has been challenging for the tyres and we had to manage some issues through both long stages and unfortunately lost quite a bit of time. Others have fared even worse than us so the overall position isn’t bad, and the rain might bring a very different set of challenges for tomorrow.” Hyundai's Adrien Fourmaux was in fourth place with Ford's Josh McErlean fifth and Paraguayan Rally2 driver Diego Dominguez sixth in a Toyota. Paraguay is appearing on the world championship calendar for the second time. Evans leads Pajari by 30 points in the standings with Katsuta 41 off the lead.

item.title: サッカー＝鎌田と冨安が先発のパレス、マンＣに4失点敗戦
item.description: ［２８日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２８日　ロイター］ - サッカーのイングランド・プレミアリーグは２８日、１試合を行い、鎌田大地と冨安健洋が先発したクリスタルパレスはホームでマンチェスター・シティー（マンＣ）と対戦し、１─４で敗れた。

パレスは前半１７分、クロスからアーリング・ハーランドに頭で決められて失点。１点ビハインドのまま迎えた後半９分にはラヤン・シェルキに追加点を奪われたが、同１１分にはジェレミ・ピノの直接ＦＫがバーに弾かれた後にＧＫに当たってネットを揺らし、１点を返した。

しかし同１４分にシェルキにミドルシュートを決められて再び２点差とされると、同３９分にはハーランドにもこの日２ゴール目を奪われた。鎌田はフル出場、左足を気にする様子を見せていた冨安は同２９分に交代した。

ハーランドは開幕２連勝とした試合後、「監督が代わって何人かの新戦力が加わったが、チームとしてまとまることができている。良いプレーができた。勝利できてうれしい」と述べた。

item.title: テニス＝錦織、坂本に敗れ全米ＯＰ予選敗退 現役最後の四大大会
item.description: ［２８日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２８日　ロイター］ - テニスの四大大会最終戦、全米オープン（ＯＰ）は２８日、ニューヨークでシングルス予選３回戦を行い、錦織圭は坂本怜との日本勢対決に敗れ、本戦進出を逃した。

今季限りでの現役引退を表明している錦織は、２０歳の坂本に４─６、６─７で敗れた。錦織にとっては現役最後の四大大会となった。

望月慎太郎はフランチェスコ・パッサロ（イタリア）に４─６、２─６で敗れたものの、欠場者による繰り上がりで出られる「ラッキールーザー」として本戦行きが決まった。

女子では坂詰姫野がミア・リスティッチ（セルビア）を６─４、６─３で退け、本戦出場を決めた。日比野菜緒は敗れた。

item.title: サッカー＝伊東が今季初ゴール、横山も先発 ゲンクは快勝
item.description: ［２８日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２８日　ロイター］ - サッカーのベルギー１部は２８日に１試合を行い、ゲンクの伊東純也がホームのベフェレン戦で今季初ゴールを決めた。

伊東は１─０で迎えた前半１９分、相手のミスを見逃さずペナルティーエリア内でボールを拾い、左足でゴールネットを揺らしてリードを広げた。ゲンクはその後、２点を追加し、４─０で快勝した。

伊東はフル出場。チームメートの横山歩夢も先発出場し、後半２６分までプレーした。

item.title: Comentarista britânico de extrema-direita Milo Yiannopoulos é detido pelo ICE
item.description: O comentarista britânico de extrema-direita Milo Yiannopoulos, que defendeu a instalação de postos de controle do ICE em supermercados nos Estados Unidos, com a deportação sumária de qualquer pessoa que não comprovasse residência legal no país, foi detido pelo Serviço de Imigração e Alfândega dos EUA, segundo registros da agência divulgados nesta sexta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Kristina Cooke, Steve Gorman
item.content:encoded: O comentarista britânico de extrema-direita Milo Yiannopoulos, que defendeu a instalação de postos de controle do ICE em supermercados nos Estados Unidos, com a deportação sumária de qualquer pessoa que não comprovasse residência legal no país, foi detido pelo Serviço de Imigração e Alfândega dos EUA, segundo registros da agência divulgados nesta sexta-feira. Yiannopoulos, de 41 anos, foi preso na quinta-feira no Aeroporto Internacional Louis Armstrong, em Nova Orleans, e está sujeito a uma ordem definitiva de expulsão dos EUA, informou o Departamento de Segurança Interna dos EUA (DHS), órgão ao qual o ICE é subordinado, em comunicado que o descreveu como “um estrangeiro em situação irregular proveniente do Reino Unido”. De acordo com o DHS, Yiannopoulos entrou legalmente nos EUA em maio de 2019 pela cidade de Nova York, mas “optou por permanecer no país além do prazo permitido, violando as leis de nossa nação”. “Yiannopoulos recebeu uma ordem definitiva de deportação de um juiz de imigração em 22 de julho, após não comparecer à sua audiência de imigração”, afirmou o comunicado do DHS. “Ele permanecerá sob custódia do ICE enquanto aguarda a deportação.” Yiannopoulos não estava disponível para comentar imediatamente e não ficou claro se ele havia contratado um advogado. O site de notícias sobre celebridades TMZ.com, que divulgou a notícia de sua prisão, sugeriu que Yiannopoulos, que mantém laços estreitos com o astro do hip-hop anteriormente conhecido como Kanye West, estava em Nova Orleans antes da apresentação do músico marcada para a noite desta sexta-feira naquela cidade. A detenção de Yiannopoulos pelo ICE marcou uma reviravolta irônica para o comentarista político, conhecido por seus comentários de extrema-direita, incluindo retórica anti-islâmica e apoio à aplicação de leis de imigração que vão além da repressão instituída pelo presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump. Em uma postagem de junho de 2025 na plataforma de mídia social X, ele afirmou que a Califórnia “precisa de postos de controle do ICE nas entradas de supermercados, postos de gasolina, shoppings, cruzamentos e prédios governamentais, com deportação imediata para qualquer pessoa que não possa provar que está nos EUA legalmente”. Além de sua associação com West, Yiannopoulos já trabalhou com o nacionalista branco Nick Fuentes. Ele começou a trabalhar em 2014 para o site de direita Breitbart News, onde ganhou notoriedade por seu papel de destaque na campanha antifeminista de assédio “Gamergate”, que tinha como alvo mulheres na indústria de videogames.

item.title: Trump annonce un accord pétrolier entre les USA et le Venezuela
item.description: Le président américain Donald Trump a annoncé vendredi que les Etats-Unis et le Venezuela avaient conclu un accord pétrolier.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le président américain Donald Trump a annoncé vendredi que les Etats-Unis et le Venezuela avaient conclu un accord pétrolier. "A ma demande, le secrétaire d'Etat Marco Rubio et le secrétaire à la Guerre Pete Hegseth, travaillant étroitement avec la très respectée présidente par intérim du Venezuela, Delcy Rodriguez, et par un partenariat avec des entreprises privées, ont assuré le contrôle majoritaire des Etats-Unis sur plus de 65 milliards de barils de pétrole provenant des réserves vénézuéliennes, et cela sans aucun coût pour les contribuables américains", a écrit Donald Trump sur son réseau, Truth Social. Le président américain changé en septembre dernier le nom du département de la Défense, le rebaptisant "département de la Guerre". Donald Trump a déclaré que l'accord permettrait de voir les réserves de pétrole américaines plus que doubler. Depuis la capture du président vénézuélien Nicolas Maduro lors d'une opération militaire des Etats-Unis à Caracas en janvier dernier, Washington tente de s'assurer des flux stables de pétrole vénézuélien, tout en promouvant les investissements américains dans le secteur énergétique du pays. L'administration Trump est sous pression à l'approche des élections de mi-mandat, notamment en raison de la hausse des prix du carburant.

item.title: Trump anuncia iniciativa abrangente dos EUA para assumir controle de vastas reservas de petróleo da Venezuela
item.description: O presidente norte-americano, Donald Trump, anunciou nesta sexta-feira uma iniciativa sem precedentes dos Estados Unidos para assumir o controle de um quinto das vastas reservas de petróleo da Venezuela, apostando que as empresas norte-americanas possam revitalizar o setor energético do país membro da Opep e, ao mesmo tempo, proporcionar uma nova fonte de petróleo bruto para ajudar a reduzir os preços dos combustíveis nos EUA.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente norte-americano, Donald Trump, anunciou nesta sexta-feira uma iniciativa sem precedentes dos Estados Unidos para assumir o controle de um quinto das vastas reservas de petróleo da Venezuela, apostando que as empresas norte-americanas possam revitalizar o setor energético do país membro da Opep e, ao mesmo tempo, proporcionar uma nova fonte de petróleo bruto para ajudar a reduzir os preços dos combustíveis nos EUA. Trump forneceu poucos detalhes sobre o acordo, dizendo apenas que os EUA haviam garantido o controle majoritário de mais de 65 bilhões de barris das reservas comprovadas de petróleo da Venezuela por meio de uma parceria com o setor privado. “Sob minha orientação, o secretário de Estado, Marco Rubio, e o secretário da Guerra, Pete Hegseth, trabalhando em estreita colaboração com a altamente respeitada presidente interina da Venezuela, Delcy Rodríguez, e por meio de uma parceria com o setor privado, garantiram o controle majoritário dos EUA sobre mais de 65 BILHÕES DE BARRIS das reservas comprovadas de petróleo na Venezuela, sem nenhum custo para o contribuinte americano”, escreveu Trump no Truth Social. O anúncio ocorre após semanas de negociações entre os EUA e a Venezuela sobre um acordo que daria a empresas norte-americanas acesso de longo prazo a um conjunto de campos petrolíferos venezuelanos e garantiria o fornecimento de petróleo bruto resultante aos Estados Unidos. Fontes haviam informado anteriormente à Reuters que um modelo de arrendamento estava sendo considerado, com os campos potencialmente leiloados para produtores norte-americanos, mas o acordo poderia enfrentar desafios legais e constitucionais na Venezuela, onde o Estado mantém o controle sobre as principais atividades do setor petrolífero. O acordo representaria uma expansão dramática do papel dos EUA na indústria petrolífera venezuelana, à medida que o governo Trump busca revitalizar a produção deteriorada do país e garantir mais petróleo bruto para as refinarias norte-americanas. A Venezuela detém as maiores reservas comprovadas de petróleo do mundo, mas produz apenas cerca de 1,25 milhão de barris por dia, muito abaixo de seu potencial após anos de subinvestimento, má gestão e sanções. O anúncio de Trump forneceu poucos detalhes sobre a estrutura do acordo, os campos ou empresas envolvidos, ou como os Estados Unidos exerceriam o controle majoritário sobre as reservas. Desde que os EUA capturaram e destituíram o ex-presidente Nicolás Maduro do poder em janeiro, Washington vem tentando garantir um fluxo estável de petróleo bruto venezuelano para as refinarias norte-americanas, ao mesmo tempo em que promove o investimento norte-americano na indústria petrolífera do país. O governo do presidente Donald Trump está sob pressão antes das eleições de meio de mandato, marcadas para novembro, devido ao aumento dos preços da gasolina, que poderia ser amenizado por meio de suprimentos de petróleo mais baratos e da ampliação da produção. Os EUA também vêm buscando soluções para reabastecer sua Reserva Estratégica de Petróleo, o estoque de petróleo, incluindo a possibilidade de trocas de petróleo bruto com produtores norte-americanos. (Reportagem de Costas Pitas e Christian Martinez)

item.title: Aneel mantém bandeira tarifária amarela em setembro para consumidores de energia
item.description: A bandeira tarifária para os consumidores de energia seguirá amarela em setembro, como vem sendo desde o mês de maio, segundo nota divulgada pela Agência Nacional de Energia Elétrica (Aneel) nesta sexta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A bandeira tarifária para os consumidores de energia seguirá amarela em setembro, como vem sendo desde o mês de maio, segundo nota divulgada pela Agência Nacional de Energia Elétrica (Aneel) nesta sexta-feira. De acordo com o órgão, a sinalização reflete condições "menos favoráveis de geração de energia no país, com necessidade de utilização de fontes de geração com custos mais elevados". Dessa forma, a bandeira amarela indica cobrança adicional de R$1,885 na conta de luz, a cada 100 quilowatts-hora (kWh) consumidos, disse a Aneel.

item.title: EEUU firma un acuerdo petrolero con Venezuela, dice Trump
item.description: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, dijo el viernes que Estados Unidos firmó un acuerdo petrolero con Venezuela.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, dijo el viernes que Estados Unidos firmó un acuerdo petrolero con Venezuela. "Bajo mi dirección, el secretario de Estado, Marco Rubio, y el secretario de Guerra, Pete Hegseth, en estrecha colaboración con la muy respetada presidenta interina de Venezuela, Delcy Rodríguez, y a través de una alianza con el sector privado, han conseguido que Estados Unidos obtenga el control mayoritario de más de 65.000 millones de barriles de reservas probadas de petróleo en Venezuela, sin coste alguno para el contribuyente estadounidense", escribió Trump en Truth Social.

item.title: Trump says US is taking partial control of Venezuela's vast oil reserves
item.description: Trump provided few details about the agreement, saying only that the U.S. had secured majority control of more than 65 billion barrels of Venezuela's proven oil reserves through a partnership with private business.
item.dc:creator: Jarrett Renshaw
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump on Friday announced an unprecedented U.S. push to take control of a fifth of Venezuela's vast oil reserves, betting that American companies can revive the OPEC nation's battered energy industry while delivering a new source of crude to help bring down U.S. fuel prices. Trump provided few details about the agreement, saying only that the U.S. had secured majority control of more than 65 billion barrels of Venezuela's proven oil reserves through a partnership with private business. "At my direction, Secretary of State Marco Rubio, and Secretary of War Pete Hegseth, working closely with Highly Respected Interim President of Venezuela, Delcy Rodriguez, and, through a partnership with private business, have secured majority U.S. control of more than 65 BILLION BARRELS of proven Oil Reserves in Venezuela, at no cost to the American Taxpayer," Trump wrote on Truth Social. The announcement followed weeks of U.S.-Venezuelan negotiations over a deal that would give American companies long-term access to a group of Venezuelan oilfields and guarantee the resulting crude supply to the United States. Venezuelan officials are preparing to sign agreements next week granting new oil exploration and production rights to a number of companies, particularly U.S. firms. Sources previously told Reuters that a [USN:L1N44O129 TEXT:"lease model"] was under consideration, with fields potentially auctioned to U.S. producers, but the arrangement could face legal and constitutional challenges in Venezuela, where the state retains control over core oil industry activities. The new deal would represent a dramatic expansion of the U.S. role in Venezuela's oil industry as the Trump administration seeks to revive the country's production and secure more crude for U.S. refineries. Venezuela holds the world's largest proven oil reserves but produces only about 1.25 million barrels per day, far below its potential after years of underinvestment, mismanagement and sanctions. Trump did not disclose the structure of the agreement, the fields or companies involved nor how the United States would exercise majority control over the reserves. Secretary of State Marco Rubio described the agreement as a win for both countries, saying on X that it would secure stable, low-cost oil for the United States and help lower gasoline prices. For Venezuela, Rubio said the deal would bring nearly $100 billion in private investment, support thousands of high-paying jobs and help rebuild the country's economy. LEGAL BASIS UNCLEAR Analysts said they needed to see more details on the agreement's legal and financial structure before assessing whether it could attract significant investment. Prospects were unclear for the deal to lower gasoline prices in the short term, as developing the infrastructure needed to produce, transport and refine Venezuela's heavy crude could take years. David Goldwyn, president of Goldwyn Global Strategies, said it was unclear whether a U.S. government lease would have a legal basis under Venezuela's constitution and new hydrocarbons law, adding that there is "no precedent for having the U.S. government enter into a lease to operate oil fields." Goldwyn also questioned whether the plan would address the obstacles that have deterred investment in Venezuela for years. "It is hard to see how this kind of arrangement would accelerate investment at any material scale," he said, citing political uncertainty, an inadequate power grid, limited export capacity and government discretion over the industry. Since the U.S. captured and removed former President Nicolas Maduro from power in January, Washington has been trying to secure a stable flow of Venezuelan crude for U.S. refineries while promoting American investment in the country's oil industry. The Trump administration is under pressure ahead of midterm elections in November to mollify consumer concerns over rising gasoline prices. Cheaper oil supplies and expanded output could help. The U.S. also has been looking for solutions to replenish its Strategic Petroleum Reserve, the oil stockpile, including the possibility of crude swaps with U.S. producers. Venezuela nationalized its oil industry in the 1970s, putting state-run PDVSA at its center. Under former President Hugo Chavez, the government tightened control, forcing foreign producers into state-led joint ventures and later expropriating assets, including projects operated by Exxon Mobil (XOM.N) and ConocoPhillips (COP.N) . Under Maduro, years of underinvestment, mismanagement, political turmoil and U.S. sanctions drove Venezuela's production sharply lower.

item.title: Fitch maintient la note de la France à A+, perspective stable
item.description: L'agence de notation financière Fitch Ratings a maintenu vendredi à A+ la note de crédit de la France qu'elle avait abaissée en septembre 2025 en raison de la flambée de la dette publique. La note est assortie d'une perspective stable.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: L'agence de notation financière Fitch Ratings a maintenu vendredi à A+ la note de crédit de la France qu'elle avait abaissée en septembre 2025 en raison de la flambée de la dette publique. La note est assortie d'une perspective stable. "Les notations de la France sont soutenues par une économie vaste, diversifiée et à haut revenu, un secteur bancaire solide et une base d'investisseurs diversifiée. Elles sont toutefois pénalisées par une dette élevée et en augmentation, un contexte politique et social rendant difficile l'assainissement des finances publiques, ainsi que par une faible croissance potentielle", commente l'agence de notation. La croissance française a stagné au deuxième trimestre, selon les chiffres définitifs publiés vendredi par l'Insee, cette révision à la baisse de la première estimation du produit intérieur brut (PIB) semant le doute sur les perspectives économiques pour la fin de l'année. Une croissance plus faible que prévu augmenterait le risque que le gouvernement ne parvienne pas à ramener le déficit à la cible de 5,0% du PIB cette année. "Le déficit a baissé de 5,8% du PIB en 2024 à 5,1% du PIB en 2025, moins que prévu mais nous n'attendons pas de nouvelles améliorations avec des déficits de 5,2% du PIB en 2026, 5,5% en 2027 et 5,2% en 2028", déclare Fitch dans sa revue. L'agence de notation prévoit désormais que la dette publique augmentera à 122,7% du PIB en 2028 contre 115,7% en 2025. Le ministre de l'Economie et des Finances, Roland Lescure, a déclaré que Bercy devrait prendre en compte la probable faiblesse du troisième trimestre lors de la mise à jour de ses prévisions de croissance et de déficit en septembre, avant la présentation du budget début octobre. Réagissant à la décision de Fitch, il a déclaré que le gouvernement restait "pleinement mobilisé pour contenir le déficit public et la dette dans un cadre responsable et équilibré, afin de garantir dans la durée la stabilité financière ainsi que la compétitivité et la croissance de l'économie française".

item.title: Cherki checks all the boxes as Man City crush Crystal Palace
item.description: Manchester City's Rayan Cherki put in a masterful second-half performance against Crystal Palace, netting two goals as his side cantered to a 4-1 away win that will have eased the minds of many supporters after an unconvincing opening-day win against Bournemouth last week.
item.dc:creator: Philip O'connor
item.content:encoded: Manchester City's Rayan Cherki put in a masterful second-half performance against Crystal Palace, netting two goals as his side cantered to a 4-1 away win that will have eased the minds of many supporters after an unconvincing opening-day win against Bournemouth last week. Cherki provided the assists for both goals as City came back from a goal down to win their opener at home, but on Friday he and Erling Haaland both opened their accounts for the new league campaign, with the pair grabbing two goals each in an easy win for the visitors. Haaland opened the scoring in the first half with a header, but it was Cherki's brace that grabbed the eye as he displayed the full range of skills that prompted City to pay a reputed €40 million to Olympique Lyonnais for his services two years ago. His first goal showcased his speed as he skipped through the massed ranks of the Palace defence before slipping a left-footed shot past Dean Henderson that took almost everyone in the stadium by surprise. After Palace reduced the deficit, Cherki struck again almost immediately to extinguish any hopes of a comeback and seal City's second consecutive league win of the season. Haaland then added a late fourth, but the goal did little to soften Cherki's critical assessment of his own efforts. "My performance is so-so. In the first half, we didn't find the space, I played bad. I need to show them I want to play, I want to score. Next time I want to give the ball around more," he said bluntly. It's unlikely new City manager Enzo Maresca shared that assessment after another match-winning contribution, and Haaland was much more charitable about his side in his post-match comments. "It's been a short pre-season. Rayan five weeks ago was at the World Cup. Game by game, we'll be back, just need a few games," he said. "We played well, it's a new manager but we've been playing together, with the addition of a few new players. We know what to do and have to trust the system." City may still be shaking off the cobwebs, but as long as Cherki is capable of sparking into life, they will not drop too many points in the opening phase of the new season. "I'm very happy for the win, see you next week. (Former City coach) Pep (Guardiola leaving) was a big story, we will start another story. We want to prove it and are here for that."

item.title: Pegula, Tiafoe see progress on diversity in tennis at US Open
item.description: American players Jessica Pegula and Frances Tiafoe said tennis is moving in the right direction on diversity as Tiafoe highlighted increased representation at the top of the game and the financial barriers facing young players.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: American players Jessica Pegula and Frances Tiafoe said tennis is moving in the right direction on diversity as Tiafoe highlighted increased representation at the top of the game and the financial barriers facing young players. Pegula said the sport's global reach was one of its strengths, pointing to players from around the world and the varied fan bases they attract. "I think the best part of tennis is there is so much diversity," Pegula told reporters on Friday in Flushing Meadows ahead of the U.S. Open. "Everybody from around the world can play." Pegula cited representation among Black players, as well as the growth of tennis in Asia due to players such as Alex Eala of the Philippines and Qinwen Zheng of China. "You see talent from all over the world. I think it's honestly one of the most diverse sports." The New York setting of the U.S. Open shares that diversity, Pegula said. "You see a lot of different countries and fans and different types of people come out and support who they love to support," she said. Tiafoe said representation in the women's game had been strong for years and pointed to an increasing number of players from a range of backgrounds competing near the top of the men's game. Tiafoe and France's Arthur Fils made history at the [USN:L6N44K09M TEXT:" Cincinnati Open"] last week when they became the first Black players to face each other in an ATP 1000 tournament final. "That's never happened in tennis. That's a huge thing," Tiafoe said. Tiafoe stressed that access remained a major challenge in tennis. "USTA is doing great getting underserved community kids to play the game. Obviously, so many things cost, racquets, strings, coaching, shoes, whatever." The USTA's 2026 U.S. Tennis Participation Report said 3.7 million Black Americans played tennis at least once in 2025, an increase of more than 450,000 players from the previous year. The report also showed broader changes in the demographic profile of U.S. tennis players. Hispanic/Latino players accounted for 19% of participants in 2025, up from 18% in 2024, while Asian/Pacific Islander players accounted for 11%, unchanged from the previous year. While he said the sport was progressing, Tiafoe cautioned that affordability could not be solved quickly. "Yeah, it's going the right direction," he said. "It's not something that's going to change overnight. Cost is cost, right? It's got to come from somewhere."

item.title: Petróleo cai após sinais de aperto monetário nos EUA e rumores de avanço em Ormuz
item.description: Os preços do petróleo fecharam em queda nesta sexta-feira, registrando também queda na semana, à medida que os operadores avaliavam indícios sobre a política de combate à inflação do Federal Reserve dos Estados Unidos e rumores de um possível acordo sobre o tráfego marítimo pelo Estreito de Ormuz.
item.dc:creator: Erwin Seba
item.content:encoded: Os preços do petróleo fecharam em queda nesta sexta-feira, registrando também queda na semana, à medida que os operadores avaliavam indícios sobre a política de combate à inflação do Federal Reserve dos Estados Unidos e rumores de um possível acordo sobre o tráfego marítimo pelo Estreito de Ormuz. Os contratos futuros do petróleo Brent fecharam a US$89,31 por barril, com queda de 0,43%. Os contratos futuros do petróleo West Texas Intermediate (WTI) fecharam a US$83,40 por barril, com queda de 0,16%. Na semana, o Brent fechou com queda de mais de 5% e o WTI, de mais de 4%. Após comentários do novo chair do Fed, Kevin Warsh, apontando para um possível aumento da taxa de juros ainda este ano para conter a inflação, os preços do petróleo caíram ainda mais, disse Phil Flynn, analista sênior do Price Futures Group. “Os mercados (globais) de produtos parecem sólidos diante de novos ataques da Ucrânia a refinarias russas”, disse Flynn. “Mas há muitos rumores de que poderíamos ver um acordo para reabrir o Estreito de Ormuz no fim de semana.” A guerra dos EUA e de Israel contra o Irã completou seu sexto mês nesta sexta-feira. Os operadores acompanhavam a recuperação instável do fluxo de petróleo pelo estreito, por onde passavam 20% da produção global de petróleo antes do início da guerra. “O mercado foi surpreendido pelo fluxo adicional, pelo corredor de transporte Irã-Omã e pelas alegações dos EUA sobre a remoção de minas”, disse o analista da Rystad, Janiv Shah. “A queda semanal provavelmente se deve ao volume disponível que consegue sair do Estreito e ao ritmo de aumento dos fluxos. Isso permitiria que as refinarias asiáticas adquirissem e consumissem”, disse ele. Nesta semana, os EUA anunciaram o que chamaram de “as sanções mais duras da história” contra o Irã. Teerã afirmou que as sanções eram um “ato desumano e hostil” que havia perdido sua eficácia. Os mediadores estão intensificando os esforços para conseguir a reabertura do Estreito de Ormuz. Teerã concordou em elaborar uma lista de condições para restaurar o tráfego normal depois que um emissário do Catar pressionou os iranianos a respeitar a liberdade de navegação.

item.title: Sal Stewart sets franchise rookie RBI record as Reds top Cubs
item.description: Tyler Stephenson belted a three-run homer and Sal Stewart drove in two runs to set the franchise rookie record for RBIs in a season, fueling the visiting Cincinnati Reds to a 10-8 victory over the Chicago Cubs on Friday afternoon.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Tyler Stephenson belted a three-run homer and Sal Stewart drove in two runs to set the franchise rookie record for RBIs in a season, fueling the visiting Cincinnati Reds to a 10-8 victory over the Chicago Cubs on Friday afternoon. Stewart went deep in the fifth inning for his team-leading 29th homer of the season. It also marked his 101st RBI, snapping a tie for the franchise rookie record that Jim Greengrass set in 1953. Stewart added the go-ahead RBI single in the sixth inning before Stephenson deposited a 1-2 fastball from Trent Thornton (5-5) over the wall in center field to stake Cincinnati to a 7-3 lead. Stephenson's homer was his 13th of the season and first since Aug. 16. Jose Trevino launched a solo homer, TJ Friedl also went deep and Elly De La Cruz ripped a two-run single among his three hits. Cincinnati scored 10 runs for the second straight game to make a winner out of Rhett Lowder (6-8), who allowed three runs on six hits in five innings. Chicago's Pedro Ramirez belted a three-run homer off Tejay Antone inside the right-field foul pole in the eighth inning to trim the Reds' lead to 9-7. Seiya Suzuki ripped an RBI double off Sam Moll to halve the deficit, however Friedl homered in the top of the ninth and Emilio Pagan retired the side in the bottom of the inning to secure his 18th save. Michael Busch belted a two-run homer and Suzuki joined Nico Hoerner in collecting three hits apiece for the Cubs, who have lost six of their last eight games. Chicago jumped out to a 3-0 lead before rookie Hector Rodriguez ripped an RBI single to put Cincinnati on the scoreboard. Stewart sent a 3-1 curveball from David Peterson over the wall in center field to trim the Reds' deficit, and Trevino deposited a first-pitch fastball from Thornton to forge a 3-3 tie. Thornton permitted five runs on four hits in two-thirds of an inning. Alex Bregman's RBI double opened the scoring in the first inning before Busch deposited a 1-1 fastball from Lowder over the wall in right field to take Chicago to a 3-0 lead in the third. --Field Level Media

item.title: CVC-backed Bamboo Insurance Services files for US IPO
item.description: CVC-backed Bamboo Insurance Services filed for a U.S. IPO on Friday, signaling renewed interest among insurers to go public in a booming market for new listings.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: CVC-backed Bamboo Insurance Services filed for a U.S. IPO on Friday, signaling renewed interest among insurers to go public in a booming market for new listings. The broader IPO market has enjoyed renewed momentum on the back of bumper listings expected in the year ahead, despite a lull at the start of the year due to a volatile market. Founded in 2018 and led by industry veteran John Chu, Bamboo focuses on the residential property market — providing homeowners' insurance and related products. The company bills itself as a technology firm, pointing to its use of advanced analytics to enable efficient underwriting in a challenging market for insurers due to a heightened frequency of unpredictable weather-related incidents. Bamboo, which launched in California at a time when several wildfires pushed insurers to scale back operations in the state, has grown to manage nearly $900 million in premiums. While the firm intends to retain focus on California, it is also expanding to other states. The company launched in Texas last year, saying it had seen profitable growth in the region. White Mountains Insurance, which was a major shareholder in the firm, sold a majority stake to CVC last year, [USN:L6N3VK0HH TEXT:"valuing the company"] at $1.75 billion. Bamboo reported total revenue of $173 million for the six months through June 30, compared with $124 million in the same period a year earlier. Its managed premiums have nearly doubled from $451 million. The company intends to list on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "BMB". J.P. Morgan, Morgan Stanley, Deutsche Bank Securities, Evercore ISI and Wells Fargo Securities are serving as the underwriters of the offering.

item.title: Yankees LHP Max Fried (elbow) to return from IL to face Red Sox
item.description: Left-handed pitcher Max Fried will return from the injured list to start one of Saturday's two games against the Boston Red Sox, New York Yankees manager Aaron Boone told reporters Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Left-handed pitcher Max Fried will return from the injured list to start one of Saturday's two games against the Boston Red Sox, New York Yankees manager Aaron Boone told reporters Friday. Lefty Carlos Rodon will start the other game, though Boone has not decided who will start which game. Fried, 32, has been out since Aug. 14 with a bone bruise in his left elbow that caused him to miss two months earlier this season. He made five starts since his initial return from the IL on July 22 and allowed one run or fewer in four of them. He held the Seattle Mariners to one run on five hits in five innings Aug. 13 in a hard-luck 1-0 loss. Fried is 4-4 with a 2.81 ERA over 15 starts with 79 strikeouts and 27 walks. The three-time All-Star is in his second season with the Yankees and won an MLB-best 19 games in 2025. Fellow lefty Jake Bennett is scheduled to start the first game of the doubleheader for the Red Sox, while the starter for the second game has not yet been announced. --Field Level Media

item.title: MLB suspends Dominican prospect in age-fraud case
item.description: A once-prized prospect from the Dominican Republic has been suspended by Major League Baseball after a league investigation revealed the player was part of an elaborate plot to portray him as nearly two years younger than he actually was, ESPN reported Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A once-prized prospect from the Dominican Republic has been suspended by Major League Baseball after a league investigation revealed the player was part of an elaborate plot to portray him as nearly two years younger than he actually was, ESPN reported Friday. The age-fraud plot included extreme efforts by the player's handler such as falsifying school and medical records, faking birth and death certificates and even staging a gravesite, per the report. A switch-hitting infielder going by the name of David Severino agreed in December to a $2.8 million pre-deal with the Cleveland Guardians, who reportedly believed the player was 13 or 14 years old. The deal was set to be finalized in 2029, when Severino was expected to be 17 and eligible to officially sign. In reality, per ESPN's sources, Severino is 16 years old and named Daury David Severino Damaso. In 2023, Francisco Nieves, Severino's trainer at the time, allegedly created the false identity of David Severino Damaso, posed as Daury's younger brother. Nieves reportedly created a false death certificate for Daury, claiming he died of a respiratory illness two years after he was born, and even built a fake tombstone that was planted at a gravesite in the Dominican Republic. John Pereyra is a trainer who has been in the business for more than 30 years and currently runs an academy called Futuro Big Leaguers out of Santiago that he says has funneled more than 70 players to MLB. Pereyra said he was told when he first saw Severino work out that he was 11 years old, and he ultimately agreed to pay Nieves $20,000 for Severino's rights. Pereyra trained Severino for two years leading up to the agreement with the Guardians but said he knew nothing about the age-fraud plot. He said he had some initial suspicions when he learned Severino's parents filed his birth certificate late, but this is not an uncommon practice in poor areas. When he learned Severino's younger brother died young, "I did my own investigation," he told ESPN, even visiting the brother's supposed grave, which he said eased his concerns. He only learned of an issue when he received a message from Nieves in May that MLB was investigating Severino's deal, which soon thereafter fell apart. Pereyra said he doesn't place blame on Severino or his parents for going along with the plot, citing the desperation to escape poverty. "When you have a kid," Pereyra said in Spanish, per ESPN, "and you tell him, ‘Look, your name is not Daury. If someone asks your name, you say, ‘David Severino Damaso" -- (he will) do it." Although poverty-stricken areas in the Dominican Republic and Venezuela have been ripe for age and identity fraud by players desperate for an advantage to make it to the majors, the extent of this scheme reportedly shocked team executives, trainers and scouts. "You have to have (guts) to do something like this," Pereyra said, per ESPN. "I've heard about false birth documents and stuff like that, but to put together what this guy did -- that's movie stuff. That's the first time I've ever seen anything like that in the Dominican. In my life, I have never seen anything like that." It is unclear what prompted MLB to investigate Severino, whose agreement with Cleveland was canceled back in May. The league, the Guardians and Nieves have not commented on the matter. --Field Level Media

item.title: Moody's revises Nigeria's outlook to 'positive'
item.description: Moody's on Friday revised Nigeria's outlook to "positive" from "stable", citing the country's improved ability to withstand external shocks due to its increased foreign exchange reserves and stronger-than-expected economic growth.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Moody's on Friday revised Nigeria's outlook to "positive" from "stable", citing the country's improved ability to withstand external shocks due to its increased foreign exchange reserves and stronger-than-expected economic growth. Africa's third-largest economy, a major oil producer, has benefitted from a surge in crude prices due to the Middle East conflict and a ramp-up in refined petroleum product exports, boosting the country's current account surplus. Moody's said it expects the West African nation's surplus "to remain sizeable even under materially lower oil prices." The World Bank has projected Nigeria's economic expansion at about [USN:L1N40Q0MO TEXT:"4.2% in 2026"], and has said stronger oil revenue, fiscal discipline and tight monetary policy could help strengthen macroeconomic stability and contain inflation. Moody's affirmed the country's ratings at "B3" as it reflects fiscal pressures arising from limited revenue-generation capacity and weak debt affordability, notwithstanding a moderate debt burden. Peer S&P Global Ratings in May upgraded Nigeria's sovereign rating to "B" from "B-", citing sustained structural reforms and improving credit worthiness, while a month earlier, Fitch affirmed Nigeria's rating at "B" with a "stable outlook".

item.title: US FDA approves Takeda, Protagonist's drug for rare blood cancer
item.description: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has approved a first-of-its-kind drug from Takeda Pharmaceutical and Protagonist Therapeutics to treat a rare blood cancer, the health regulator said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Kamal Choudhury, Mariam Sunny
item.content:encoded: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has approved a first-of-its-kind drug from Takeda Pharmaceutical (4502.T) and Protagonist Therapeutics (PTGX.O) to treat a rare blood cancer, the health regulator said on Friday. The approval of rusfertide brings a highly anticipated, less-invasive treatment option for thousands of patients who have historically relied on frequent bloodletting procedures to manage their condition. The drug treats polycythemia vera, a rare, slow-growing blood cancer affecting roughly 90,000 Americans. The condition causes the bone marrow to overproduce red blood cells, thickening the blood and sharply raising the risk of life-threatening clots, strokes and heart attacks. Rusfertide, branded as Mimrylo, will be made available to patients within 48 hours of FDA approval, Teresa Bitetti, president of Takeda's global oncology business unit, told Reuters in an interview. While the company did not disclose the exact list price of the drug at launch, Bitetti said the company would "price this in a way that is fair to the value, but then also ensures that there's access for patients." Takeda is projecting peak global sales for the drug in the range of $1 billion to $2 billion. For decades, treatment has largely relied on therapeutic phlebotomy, a procedure that involves regularly removing blood to keep red blood cell levels under control. Mimrylo works by mimicking hepcidin, the body's master iron-regulating hormone, to restrict iron availability and prevent the bone marrow from overproducing red blood cells. The FDA's decision was based on late-stage trials, in which the drug, alongside standard of care, helped patients control their red blood cell levels, reducing the need for painful blood draws, and improving symptoms like fatigue. Takeda secured the global rights to co-develop and commercialize the drug from its developer Protagonist through a 2024 licensing agreement.

item.title: Marquinhos grabs late equaliser as PSG draw 2-2 with Lille
item.description: Paris St Germain defender Marquinhos scored deep into stoppage time to snatch a scarcely-deserved 2-2 draw at Lille on Friday as the Ligue 1 champions continued to struggle after their opening weekend draw against Rennes.
item.dc:creator: Philip O'connor
item.content:encoded: Paris St Germain defender Marquinhos scored deep into stoppage time to snatch a scarcely-deserved 2-2 draw at Lille on Friday as the Ligue 1 champions continued to struggle after their opening weekend draw against Rennes. Kick-off was delayed by 15 minutes due to a problem with the ticketing system at the stadium, but when the game eventually got underway both sides wasted no time getting on the attack. Achraf Hakimi flashed an early shot wide for the visitors and Olivier Giroud forced a save from PSG keeper Matvey Safonov. After their poor 2-2 draw against Rennes, things went from bad to worse for PSG when Lille took the lead in the 21st minute as Icelandic playmaker Hakon Arnar Haraldsson latched on to a brilliant reverse pass from Giroud and curled an unstoppable shot past Safonov. Despite all their attacking riches, the Parisians struggled to get shots on target as Lille packed their defence and forced the champions to attack from wide areas, and Lille looked to have secured the three points when Dilane Bakwa netted in the 84th minute. PSG midfielder Vitinha threw his side a lifeline in the first minute of stoppage time with a superb strike curled into the top-left corner, and the Portuguese international then crossed for Marquinhos to head home the equaliser four minutes later to complete an improbable comeback. Lille top the standings on four points from their opening two games, with PSG sixth on two points after their latest great escape.

item.title: Brilliant Bayern ease to 5-1 Bundesliga win over Stuttgart
item.description: Bayern Munich kick-started their Bundesliga title defence with a resounding 5-1 victory over Stuttgart thanks to a sparkling second half display at the Allianz Arena on Friday that showed they have lost none of their potency from last season.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bayern Munich kick-started their Bundesliga title defence with a resounding 5-1 victory over Stuttgart thanks to a sparkling second half display at the Allianz Arena on Friday that showed they have lost none of their potency from last season. Goals from Dayot Upamecano, Michael Olise, Aleksandar Pavlovic and Luis Diaz capped a superb performance from the hosts during which they also missed several other opportunities. It was a mixed night for Stuttgart’s Josha Vagnoman, who scored at both ends having briefly equalised early in the second half, as Bayern extended their unbeaten run in their opening game of the new campaign to 15 matches. Bayern won the Bundesliga title by 16 points last season, scoring a record 122 goals in the process, and there are signs they could be as dominant again as they created chance after chance against the side who finished fourth last term. They took the lead on 21 minutes when Upamecano headed home Joshua Kimmich’s corner from close-range, deftly glancing the ball into the net. Both teams hit the woodwork in the first half but Bayern led by the narrowest of margins at the break. Stuttgart levelled seven minutes into the second period when Jeff Chabot was denied by a fine save from Manuel Neuer, but Vagnoman fired in the rebound. Their joy was short-lived though as two Bayern strikes in three minutes proved decisive. First Olise had time and space to finish after Kimmich latched onto Angelo Stiller’s poor pass and the unfortunate Vagnoman then bundled Alphonso Davies’ low cross into his own net as he slipped while trying to clear. Olise had a goal ruled out for offside and Diaz was denied on several occasions, but Bayern did get their fourth when Ismael Saibari put the ball on a plate for Pavlovic to score a tap-in. Diaz finally got his goal with a late strike from Saibari's pass to cap an ominous display from the Bavarians.

item.title: Chevron cerrará acuerdo en Venezuela para migrar y expandir sus proyectos petroleros: fuentes
item.description: Chevron está a punto de finalizar las negociaciones para integrar todas sus empresas mixtas petroleras en Venezuela al nuevo marco energético del país, lo que permitirá a la compañía estadounidense un mayor control sobre las operaciones y las expansiones de los yacimientos petroleros, según dos fuentes cercanas a las negociaciones.
item.dc:creator: Marianna Parraga
item.content:encoded: Chevron está a punto de finalizar las negociaciones para integrar todas sus empresas mixtas petroleras en Venezuela al nuevo marco energético del país, lo que permitirá a la compañía estadounidense un mayor control sobre las operaciones y las expansiones de los yacimientos petroleros, según dos fuentes cercanas a las negociaciones. El acuerdo, que se espera se anuncie el miércoles, incluirá un intercambio de activos previamente informado que permitirá que el proyecto de crudo pesado Petropiar de la compañía, el más grande en Venezuela, se expanda al bloque vecino Ayacucho 8. Una segunda área en la vasta Faja del Orinoco también participa en las negociaciones para extender un proyecto más pequeño en esa zona, según la fuente. Según las fuentes, la empresa, el Ministerio de Hidrocarburos de Venezuela y la estatal PDVSA también han mantenido conversaciones recientes sobre una posible nueva zona petrolera que podría añadirse a la cartera. Un portavoz de Chevron no quiso hacer comentarios cuando fue contactado por Reuters. Según las fuentes, se espera que la firma del acuerdo el miércoles incluya la transferencia de contratos con otras compañías extranjeras.

item.title: Germany and Spain to contest men’s Hockey World Cup final
item.description: Spain came from a goal down to edge co-hosts Netherlands 4-3 in their men’s Hockey World Cup semi-final on Friday and will play Germany in Sunday’s final.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Spain came from a goal down to edge co-hosts Netherlands 4-3 in their men’s Hockey World Cup semi-final on Friday and will play Germany in Sunday’s final. The Germans were 2-1 winners over Argentina in Friday’s second semi-final in Wavre, Belgium. The Netherlands had a 1-0 lead late in the third quarter in their clash at Amstelveen, but Spain equalised through José Basterra and then went on to win the match when the Dutch had Duco Telgenkamp yellow-carded and penalised for 10 minutes. Basterra tipped in for Spain to take the lead and a penalty corner converted by Pepe Cunill put Spain up 3-1, after which Basterra completed his hat-trick from a penalty strike. Jip Janssen reduced the score from a penalty corner, and a minute before time, Joep de Mol also tapped in. But back to their full complement, the Dutch ran out of time intervals in their quest for an equaliser. In the other semi-final, Justus Weigand and Paul-Philipp Kaufmann scored for the Germans, while Tomas Domene scored Argentina’s equaliser from a penalty corner in a tense clash.

item.title: Qiagen owes 10x, Roche $4.8 million for infringing patents, U.S. jury says
item.description: A jury in Delaware federal court determined on Friday that Qiagen's Parse Biosciences must pay 10x Genomics' Scale Biosciences and Roche [RIC:RIC:ROGUS.UL] $4.8 million for violating their patent rights in genetic-sequencing technology.
item.dc:creator: Blake Brittain
item.content:encoded: A jury in Delaware federal court determined on Friday that Qiagen's (QIA.DE) Parse Biosciences must pay 10x Genomics' (TXG.O) Scale Biosciences and Roche [RIC:RIC:ROGUS.UL] $4.8 million for violating their patent rights in genetic-sequencing technology. The jury agreed with Scale and Roche that Parse's Evercode platform, used in biomedical research, infringes three Scale patents. The jury also determined that Parse infringed the patents willfully, which could lead a judge to multiply the award by up to three times. Parse and Qiagen said in a statement that they were disappointed with the verdict and that Parse will "continue to vigorously defend itself in this litigation." 10x said in a statement that it would seek enhanced damages, attorneys' fees and a permanent injunction against Parse following the verdict. Spokespeople for Roche did not immediately respond to a request for comment on the verdict. Scale sued Parse in 2022, alleging it infringed three cell-sequencing patents that Scale licensed from Roche. The patents' inventor Garry Nolan co-founded Scale. Parse denied the allegations and argued that the patents were invalid and has separately countersued Scale for infringing its patents. Qiagen acquired Parse last December, while California-based 10x acquired Scale last August.

item.title: Marinha do Irã afirma ter “controle total” sobre Estreito de Ormuz
item.description: A Marinha da Guarda Revolucionária do Irã rejeitou as alegações dos EUA de que o Estreito de Ormuz estava aberto, classificando-as como uma tentativa de controlar os preços do petróleo e ocultar o que descreveu como fracassos dos EUA.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Marinha da Guarda Revolucionária do Irã rejeitou as alegações dos EUA de que o Estreito de Ormuz estava aberto, classificando-as como uma tentativa de controlar os preços do petróleo e ocultar o que descreveu como fracassos dos EUA. Segundo um comunicado, a Marinha afirmou que as restrições continuariam até que as ações militares dos EUA contra o Irã cessassem e os compromissos relevantes fossem cumpridos.

item.title: Doubles for Cherki, Haaland as Man City cruise to 4-1 win over Palace
item.description: Manchester City's Rayan Cherki and Erling Haaland both struck twice as their side strolled to a 4-1 win away to Crystal Palace on Friday night to notch their second successive Premier League win.
item.dc:creator: Philip O'connor
item.content:encoded: Manchester City's Rayan Cherki and Erling Haaland both struck twice as their side strolled to a 4-1 win away to Crystal Palace on Friday night to notch their second successive Premier League win. Palace started brightly, but they went behind in the 17th minute when Haaland jumped to reach Antoine Semenyo’s cross and send a looping header beyond the despairing dive of Dean Henderson, for the Norwegian's first goal of the new league campaign. In an end-to-end affair, City's Phil Foden spooned the ball over the bar in the 21st minute and Eddie Nketiah wasted an excellent chance for the home side early in the second half before Cherki netted in the 54th minute, dancing through the defence before poking the ball home. Palace pulled a goal back two minutes later when Yeremy Pino's free kick came back off the crossbar and bounced off the back of City keeper Gianluigi Donnarumma before hitting the post and dropping into the net. But whatever hopes Palace had of staging a comeback were quickly snuffed out when French playmaker Cherki scored again in the 59th minute, flashing a deflected shot off Chris Richards and into the net for his second of the night. Not to be outdone, Haaland picked up a pass from Foden and blasted home a typical left-foot shot in the 85th minute to complete the rout for Enzo Maresca's side and give City the maximum six points from their opening two games. "Probably the first five or 10 minutes we saw how difficult it was. It's a difficult pitch and tough opponents, after 10 minutes we controlled the game on the ball and off the ball and deserved to win," Maresca said. He praised his two goal scorers, and also had some words of encouragement for Phil Foden, who took on a number of attacking roles as the coach shuffled his deck late in the game. "In the last 10-15 minutes, you can see he was even more happy to play inside behind Erling. That's his position," Maresca said. "He's trying to adapt and trying to help when playing winger, his working is good, he's doing very good." City have almost a full week off before their next game against newly-promoted Coventry City, with a sterner test the following week when they travel across town to Old Trafford to take on Manchester United in their first derby game of the season.

item.title: Reports: Florida makes Todd Golden highest-paid Gators coach ever
item.description: Florida men's basketball coach Todd Golden has signed his third contract extension in three years, raising his average annual salary to $8.25 million and making him the highest-paid coach in school history, according to multiple reports on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Florida men's basketball coach Todd Golden has signed his third contract extension in three years, raising his average annual salary to $8.25 million and making him the highest-paid coach in school history, according to multiple reports on Friday. The new deal, now six years at $49.5 million through the 2031-32 season, boosted Golden's yearly average by $2.25 million, per reports. Golden got a raise from $6 million to $7.5 million for this coming season. First-year Gators football coach Jon Sumrall, for comparison, is on a six-year, $44.7 million contract and will make $7.45 million this season. According to reports, only Kansas men's basketball coach Bill Self, UConn's Dan Hurley and Arkansas' John Calipari are paid more at the college level, while North Carolina's new head coach, Michael Malone, matches Golden at $7.5 million for this season. Golden, 41, will get an annual boost of $300,000, reaching $9 million for the 2031-32 season. The contract includes numerous guarantees, incentives and fringe benefits. If he were to leave for the NBA -- there was speculation this offseason -- Florida would be entitled to a $3 million buyout, which decreases to $2 million the following two seasons, per reports. Leaving for a collegiate program would be costlier: $16 million until March 31, 2027, but decreasing sharply in the remaining years, per reports. If Florida athletic director Scott Stricklin leaves the university, the buyout decreases by $5 million in each of the next two seasons and the NBA buyout drops to zero dollars for the remainder of the contract, the Gainesville Sun reported. His last contract extension came after the Gators won the national championship in the 2024-25 season. Golden is 103-41 (.715) overall and 50-22 in Southeastern Conference games (.694) while going 7-2 in three NCAA Tournament runs over four seasons with Florida. His head coaching record is 160-77 (.675), including three seasons at San Francisco (57-36). The Gators went 36-4 (14-4 SEC) in the championship season and 27-8 last season (16-2 SEC), when they won the regular-season title before losing in the second round of the NCAA Tournament. Florida posted back-to-back NCAA Tournament No. 1 seeds, doubling the previous total in program history. --Field Level Media

item.title: EEUU conversa con el magnate venezolano Betancourt para cerrar un acuerdo petrolero: Bloomberg News
item.description: El Gobierno de Estados Unidos está tratando de hacerse con una participación importante en las reservas petroleras venezolanas a través de una posible asociación con el empresario venezolano Alejandro Betancourt, informó el viernes Bloomberg News, que citó a personas familiarizadas con el asunto.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El Gobierno de Estados Unidos está tratando de hacerse con una participación importante en las reservas petroleras venezolanas a través de una posible asociación con el empresario venezolano Alejandro Betancourt, informó el viernes Bloomberg News, que citó a personas familiarizadas con el asunto. Las negociaciones se centran en hasta 17 yacimientos petrolíferos situados en las principales cuencas petroleras de Venezuela, mientras que se está barajando la posibilidad de que la Oficina de Capital Estratégico del Pentágono sea la encargada de supervisar la inversión, según añadió el artículo. Reuters no ha podido verificar de inmediato la información.

item.title: Chevron to complete deal in Venezuela to migrate, expand oil projects, sources say
item.description: Chevron is about to finalize negotiations to migrate all its oil joint ventures in Venezuela into the country's new energy framework, allowing the U.S. major more control over operations and key oilfield expansions, two sources close to the negotiations said.
item.dc:creator: Marianna Parraga
item.content:encoded: Chevron is about to finalize negotiations to migrate all its oil joint ventures in Venezuela into the country's new energy framework, allowing the U.S. major more control over operations and key oilfield expansions, two sources close to the negotiations said. The agreement, expected to be announced on Wednesday, will include a previously announced asset swap allowing the company's Petropiar heavy crude project, its largest in Venezuela, to expand to the neighboring Ayacucho 8 block. A second area in the vast Orinoco Belt also is involved in the negotiations to expand a smaller project there, the source said. The company, Venezuela's oil ministry and state-run PDVSA also have held recent talks for a potential new oil area that could be added to the portfolio, according to the sources. A Chevron spokesperson declined to comment when contacted by Reuters. The agreement signing on Wednesday is expected to include contract migrations with other foreign companies, the sources said.

item.title: Tribunal de Ecuador declara culpable al expresidente Lenín Moreno en caso de corrupción
item.description: Un tribunal de justicia de Ecuador declaró la responsabilidad del expresidente Lenín Moreno como autor directo del delito de cohecho, en un caso de corrupción vinculado a la construcción de una planta hidroeléctrica, informó el viernes la fiscalía del país.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Un tribunal de justicia de Ecuador declaró la responsabilidad del expresidente Lenín Moreno como autor directo del delito de cohecho, en un caso de corrupción vinculado a la construcción de una planta hidroeléctrica, informó el viernes la fiscalía del país. Durante la investigación, se vinculó a Moreno, de 73 años, miembros de su familia y a socios comerciales locales y chinos con una red de corrupción vinculada a la construcción de la central Coca Codo Sinclair adjudicada a la china Sinohydro. El tribunal determinó que Moreno, valiéndose de su condición de vicepresidente en esos momentos, ejecutó acciones para asegurar la adjudicación del contrato a la empresa china para la construcción de la central hidroeléctrica, la más grande del país andino. "La actuación de Lenín Moreno Garcés se adecúa a los términos de la acusación formulada por la Fiscalía, delito de cohecho atribuido al servidor público en calidad de autor directo", dijo el juez ponente Manuel Cabrera, durante la lectura de la sentencia. La Fiscalía había solicitado una pena de seis años y seis meses para Moreno y los demás acusados en el caso. El tribunal señalará la condena al final de la lectura de su resolución. Moreno, en su rol de vicepresidente entre 2007 y 2013, y miembros de su familia habrían recibido más de un millón de dólares en sobornos, configurando el delito de cohecho, según los fiscales. El tribunal también declaró como cómplices a la esposa e hija de Moreno, así como a sus dos hermanos y una cuñada. Sinohydro habría pagado sobornos por un valor de 76,1 millones de dólares entre 2009 y 2018, que presuntamente fueron entregados a cambio de falsos servicios de consultorías, según la investigación. Posteriormente, según la Fiscalía, los pagos fueron canalizados desde cuentas bancarias en el extranjero, mediante un "reparto porcentual" y transferidos a múltiples paraísos fiscales y empresas fachada vinculadas al mismo núcleo familiar y empresarial. "No he recibido ningún solo centavo por parte de Sinohydro, entonces por favor que no me vengan a decir que soy acusado", dijo Moreno a periodistas. "He venido a dar la cara como hombre de honor que soy para comprobar la inocencia mía y la de mi familia". La sentencia final del tribunal podrá ser apelada por los acusados. Moreno, quien también ocupó la presidencia del país entre el 2017 y 2021, regresó al país desde Paraguay, donde vivió en los últimos años, para enfrentar el juicio.

item.title: Pinterest finance chief Julia Donnelly to step down in October
item.description: Pinterest said on Friday Chief Financial Officer Julia Donnelly will leave on October 30, and the company has launched an external search for its next finance chief.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Pinterest (PINS.N) said on Friday Chief Financial Officer Julia Donnelly will leave on October 30, and the company has launched an external search for its next finance chief. Vikram Naidu, the image-sharing platform's vice president of finance and business operations, will be principal financial officer in the interim. Donnelly's "leadership helped support a period in which we delivered 11 consecutive quarters of double-digit revenue growth, significantly increased operating rigor and expanded margins to ensure the ongoing health of our business," CEO Bill Ready said in a memo to employees. Donnelly — who is leaving to pursue an opportunity at a private, early-stage company — joined Pinterest in 2023, from online furniture retailer Wayfair, where she was the global head of finance. The tenure saw Pinterest completing its acquisition of connected-TV advertising platform tvScientific and a [USN:L4N42C1BK TEXT:"$4 billion"] cloud-services partnership with Amazon Web Services. The company [USN:L4N4411XY TEXT:"forecast slower third-quarter revenue growth"] earlier this month, a sign of tough competition for digital advertising from bigger players including Meta's Instagram. (This story has been refiled to correct Donnelly's name in the bullet points.)

item.title: イラン最高指導者、当局者に結束呼びかけ 経済問題への対応も促す
item.description:
Yasmine Ghania Ahmed Tolba
[ドバイ ２８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Yasmine Ghania　Ahmed Tolba

[ドバイ ２８日 ロイター] - イランの最高指導者モジタバ・ハメネイ師は２８日、当局者に対し「社会的結束を損なういかなる行為も禁じる」とする書面の声明を発表した。

モジタバ師は当局者に対し「国家や国民の意欲を弱めるような失望を招く発言」を避けるよう求めると同時に、政府に対し、インフレや失業のほか、物価や財・サービス市場の管理を含む経済や市民生活に関わる課題に真剣に取り組むよう促した。

イラン指導部の間では、米国との戦闘で打撃を受けている経済にさらに圧力がかかることで、抗議活動が再び引き起される可能性に対する懸念が高まっている。

モジタバ師は２月２８日の米国とイスラエルによる攻撃で負傷したとされており、同攻撃から半年が経過した今も国民の前に一度も姿を見せず、肉声も伝わっていない。

item.title: Colheita de milho do Brasil avança para 88,4% da área total, diz Pátria AgroNegócios
item.description: O total colhido de milho no Brasil chegou a 88,4% da área total, aproximando-se do ritmo registrado no mesmo período do ano passado e na média histórica de cinco anos (90,2%), de acordo com relatório da consultoria Pátria AgroNegócios nesta sexta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O total colhido de milho no Brasil chegou a 88,4% da área total, aproximando-se do ritmo registrado no mesmo período do ano passado e na média histórica de cinco anos (90,2%), de acordo com relatório da consultoria Pátria AgroNegócios nesta sexta-feira. "Colheita em fase final. Resultados de produtividade variáveis em todo o país. Volume total produzido se aproxima de 104 milhões de toneladas, menor do que na safra passada", disse a consultoria. Segundo a empresa, as últimas áreas a serem colhidas se concentram entre os Estados de Minas Gerais, Paraná e São Paulo.

item.title: Vale se depara com escassez de engenheiros enquanto foca novos projetos, diz CEO
item.description: Em momento em que foca no desenvolvimento de novos projetos, a mineradora Vale tem enfrentado desafios diante da escassez de engenheiros para avançar com os empreendimentos, disse nesta sexta-feira o CEO da companhia, Gustavo Pimenta.
item.dc:creator: Roberto Samora
item.content:encoded: Em momento em que foca no desenvolvimento de novos projetos, a mineradora Vale (VALE3.SA) tem enfrentado desafios diante da escassez de engenheiros para avançar com os empreendimentos, disse nesta sexta-feira o CEO da companhia, Gustavo Pimenta. "Estamos com dificuldades de formar novos líderes, formar novos engenheiros, para a Vale, isso é uma dor...", disse ele, ressaltando que a capacitação de engenharia é fundamental para projetos complexos. "É um tema de atenção, estamos fazendo parcerias, sejam com escolas técnicas, sejam turmas de faculdades de formação, mas este é o calcanhar de Aquiles da indústria hoje, formação e capacitação", declarou a uma plateia do Lide, grupo de líderes empresariais. No ano passado, a Vale anunciou dois grandes pacotes de investimentos: R$70 bilhões no [USN:L1N3SU0L4 TEXT:"Programa Novo Carajás"] até 2030, para expandir minas e aumentar a produção de minério de ferro e cobre; além de um [USN:L1N3UR0AE TEXT:"montante"] semelhante, até 2030, nos ativos de Minas Gerais. "Com essa aceleração do próprio 'pipeline' de crescimento da Vale, estamos fazendo mais projetos, a empresa voltou a crescer... a gente se deparou com esse desafio de falta de engenheiros e de falta de empresas de engenharia fortalecidas que pudessem nos auxiliar", disse o executivo. Ainda neste mês, em evento em Brasília, Pimenta disse que o Brasil deveria voltar a realizar [USN:L6N44F0ZE TEXT:"megaprojetos"] de mineração, de US$15 bilhões a US$20 bilhões, e que a Vale tem capital para isso. Ele disse que o setor de mineração tem o desafio de mostrar para os jovens estudantes que a "indústria real" pode ser atrativa. "O que a gente faz de fato muda o mundo, acredito profundamente que a mineração faz o mundo melhor", disse. O executivo disse que a Vale tem feito muitas parcerias com o sistema S de formação profissional, mas em alguns casos a companhia tem sido obrigada "a recorrer a engenheiros fora do Brasil". "Isso não é adequado, a gente deveria ser capaz de cobrir tudo com os recursos internos." Durante o evento, Pimenta disse também que está "otimista" com a possibilidade de edição de um decreto que trata das [USN:L1N44P0MV TEXT:"cavidades"] no setor de mineração, que poderia liberar investimentos ao tornar mais célere o licenciamento ambiental.

item.title: Judge in Google privacy class action awards lawyers $147 million in legal fees
item.description: A U.S. judge on Friday awarded nearly $147 million in legal fees to plaintiffs’ lawyers who won a $425 million jury verdict against Alphabet's Google in a data privacy trial last year, while denying the company’s bid for an order rejecting the jury’s verdict.
item.dc:creator: Mike Scarcella
item.content:encoded: A U.S. judge on Friday awarded nearly $147 million in legal fees to plaintiffs’ lawyers who won a $425 million jury verdict against Alphabet's Google in a data privacy trial last year, while denying the company’s bid for an order rejecting the jury’s verdict. Here are the details: U.S. District Judge Richard Seeborg in San Francisco granted the fee request by law firms Boies Schiller Flexner, Susman Godfrey and Morgan & Morgan over objections from some class members. A jury in September found [USN:L1N3UO0MV TEXT:"Google liable"] for secretly collecting app activity data from millions of users who had disabled a tracking feature. The law firms, which had sought billions of dollars in damages at trial, said they have devoted more than 49,670 hours to the litigation. They have called the verdict “historic” and said it was likely the largest in a data privacy class action that resulted in a trial verdict. In his ruling on fees, Seeborg said “this request is, without question, extraordinary, but it is warranted by the extraordinary nature of the case as well as by the exemplary performance of counsel.” The plaintiffs’ team included veteran litigator David Boies, who said he was [USN:L6N40J0FG TEXT:"billing"] at $2,730 per hour this year. Seeborg said there is “some intuitive discomfort” based on the size of the fee award. “The lawyers are being handsomely rewarded for their success, even as each of the 98 million class members will walk away with less than $5,” the judge wrote in Friday’s order. “That is, however, a consequence of the policy choice to use the class action device to remedy widespread torts.” The plaintiffs said that only 269 class members objected to the fee request, an indication they said showed support for the overall compensation amount. Google has denied any wrongdoing and said it will appeal the verdict. The company has argued that the plaintiffs “presented no survey evidence, expert testimony, or other uniform evidence establishing that users were actually misled by Google’s disclosures.” Seeborg in a separate order on Friday denied Google’s request for a ruling summarily granting the company a win. The court also denied a request from the plaintiffs for a new trial on part of their lawsuit. Read more: [USN:L6N44L07T TEXT:"Playboy fights fee bid in dispute with ex-lawyers at Quinn Emanuel"] [USN:L6N4470C0 TEXT:"Law firm Motley Rice's fee for Meta case in New Mexico could top $67 million"] [USN:L6N4421AI TEXT:"US must pay university group's legal fees in case over Pentagon research funds"] [USN:L6N43N0AU TEXT:"In landmark Anthropic settlement, judge rejects ‘windfall’ for lawyers"]

It said the restrictions would continue until U.S. military actions against Iran end and relevant commitments are implemented, according to a
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Iran's Revolutionary Guards Corps Navy rejected U.S. claims that the Strait of Hormuz was open, calling them an attempt to control oil prices and conceal what it described as U.S. failures.
